## English translation

### lerapace1411 — 28 October 2006 at 18:55:28

> I am in the Sherwood forest and I am sending my men to the workshops.
>
> What should I do next: I cannot go into ambushes because I do not have arrows to activate the traps.
>
> Is there another place to go?

### Quedza — 28 October 2006 at 21:16:42

> Use hand-to-hand combat and weapons other than arrows for ambushes... The workshops will have supplies after a mission (a mission is not an ambush!).
>
> You generally have a choice between several places to go. You can return to the map if you change your mind.

### T_Sentenza — 29 October 2006 at 09:27:22

> Besides, in the first ambush missions you find arrows on the map.

### Quedza — 29 October 2006 at 10:14:10

> But what if he uses the arrows as soon as he finds them... If he uses the arrows in the same mission in which he finds them...

### T_Sentenza — 8 November 2006 at 11:18:34

> Yes, personally I only use arrows in ambush missions, missions where you have to capture castles (the allies make such a slaughter that you might as well kill almost everyone in that mission), and the very first mission, to drive away the soldiers who are training.

### Quedza — 9 November 2006 at 12:21:20

> In town, do you play stealthily (avoiding the guards) or as a brute (taking them out in hand-to-hand combat)?
>
> For me, it is somewhere in between: I use BINGO to get 999 arrows (I admit it is cheating), and I only shoot. I do not always hit the targets and the guards sometimes charge at me; then I use hand-to-hand combat. But I do not try to eliminate all the guards; I only kill those who bother me (those who block me, those who see me...). And I keep the number of lives I am given (I do not use "IMMUNITY").
>
> I do not like hand-to-hand combat, or more precisely, not in too large a quantity (it takes a long time... but hand-to-hand battles are good).
>
> And yes, I am the novelist (of novels) on JeuxVideo.com! lol (many people have remarked that I write novels on the forum and that this could put readers off, which I understand! I myself do not really like reading novels...).

### T_Sentenza — 17 November 2006 at 19:13:15

> In general I try to sneak behind the guards to knock them out with my fist. Otherwise, for hand-to-hand combat (I do quite a lot of it), I use Little John to spare them. For knights, I use Will Scarlet. I avoid using limited resources.

### Quedza — 18 November 2006 at 10:38:39

> Strangely, Will Scarlett spares soldiers in hand-to-hand combat (if they are not too weak) with his flail!

### T_Sentenza — 18 November 2006 at 18:29:36

> Exactly, I try to spare as many as possible. And Will Scarlet, with his powerful weapon, is ideal against resistant knights.

### lavin — 19 September 2007 at 19:57:12

> To get ammunition, position your pointer over Crouch—above all, do not click—and press F11. Do the same for this: immunity, and you become invincible.

### PremminS2 — 22 September 2007 at 14:47:43

> Well, there are quite a few people here!

### morsual — 23 September 2007 at 21:35:15

> At my place, I put the whole Sherwood gang in the workshop and take only the essential characters on missions (like Little John, Skarlet,...). And when I return from a mission, surprise! I have a good twenty bundles of 5 to 100 arrows. Otherwise, I often use hand-to-hand combat and try to eliminate as many people as possible (I know, I am sadistic, so what / ?)

### T_Sentenza — 15 October 2007 at 19:20:55

> I am very stingy^^: I only use my fist or hand-to-hand combat, rarely the net, and quite often purses against patrols without an officer, which means that in general producing at Sherwood is useless.

### alerte-rouge-2 — 19 October 2007 at 15:00:44

> I avoid killing the enemies so that I will have maximum production at Sherwood, and so I send my men to attack when there is an attack mission to protect a castle, or I send them into combat or archery, so that I can take them on missions.

### dad2 — 18 August 2011 at 18:26:44

> I managed to knock out 4 guys with Will Scarlet without them spotting me (they were grouped together).

### iPiero — 17 October 2012 at 20:55:40

> Hi, I remembered this game when I was on PC, but currently I am on Mac and the "crouch + F11" command does not work.
>
> Also, I am at Robin's hideout with a few other characters and I can only access ambushes; I have no arrows and almost no health left.
>
> How do I progress in the game?
>
> Thanks in advance.

### T_Sentenza — 21 October 2012 at 14:31:11

> The fact that you start with no arrows and almost no health: is that a bug, or were you already in that situation before setting out?
>
> If you are at the beginning of the game (and even at the end), ambushes are easy to do without arrows.

### ADN83 — 20 January 2013 at 18:11:26

> You do not have to activate the traps; if you want to knock them out, take the men with the mace, and when you return from the mission you will have arrows.

### Zapotec — 17 August 2013 at 17:02:43

> My men who stayed at Sherwood produce nothing. If I understand correctly, it is because it does not work during an ambush? What a rip-off, some characters are on the verge of death, I have no more arrows and no more herbs... Not very practical, all that.

### T_Sentenza — 18 August 2013 at 12:02:52

> Yes, your companions produce ONLY during missions, not ambushes.
>
> Honestly, I find the game very doable without arrows (except, of course, when the story requires them). Besides, you must still be near the beginning of the game, so the enemies are not difficult to defeat.
>
> Did you understand how hand-to-hand combat works? Right-click to parry blows, and hold the left mouse button and "draw" the attack you want to make.
